title: Cortical Spreading Depolarization After Severe Traumatic Brain Injury
official: Cortical Spreading Depolarization After Severe Traumatic Brain Injury
summary: Preliminary evaluation of electrodes placed on the brain for recording brain activity and novel algorithms to determine cortical spreading depolarization foci of origination following severe traumatic brain injury requiring neurosurgical intervention.

interventions.name: Continuous electrocorticography post severe traumatic brain injury requiring neurosurgical intervention

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient recommended to undergo craniectomy or craniotomy for the treatment of acute TBI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Wound determined to be contaminated
* Decompression is performed only in the posterior fossa
* Known systemic infection
* Pregnancy
